description: Trades between the app's users (neblla.db.offer / acceptOffer; what is tradable is neblla_update_app({ trade })). Action "cancel" { id }: take a pending offer back (support, abuse); both users hear it. A trade that was done is not undone from here. The actions that only look (list) are in neblla_trades_read.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

name: neblla_trades
title: Trades
